note: Colorbox Simple Load is a front-end-only module: hook_page_attachments() attaches the colorbox.attachment service plus its colorbox_simple_load/load library on every page, and js/colorbox-simple-load.js makes every link with the CSS class 'colorbox-load' open its href in a Colorbox lightbox. Per-link options come from the href query string: width->innerWidth, height->innerHeight, and true/yes|false/no coerce to booleans. It has NO admin UI, no config, no permissions, no schema, no PHP API, and depends on the colorbox module for all styling/defaults. Because it has no server-side configuration of its own, the medium/hard cases are grounded in the real usage pattern (authoring markup with the colorbox-load class and URL-param options) using a custom block whose body HTML is read back from the live site.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal module colorbox_simple_load, how do I make an ordinary link open its target inside a Colorbox lightbox? What exactly do I add to the link?
evals.expected_output: Add the CSS class colorbox-load to the anchor, e.g. View. The module's JS finds every .colorbox-load element and opens its href in a Colorbox overlay.

evals.prompt: With colorbox_simple_load, how do I control the width and height of the lightbox for one specific link? Which Colorbox options do width and height map to?
evals.expected_output: Add query parameters to the link's href, e.g. href="/node/1?width=900&height=700". The JS parses the query string into Colorbox options; width is renamed to innerWidth and height to innerHeight. Other params pass straight through, and true/yes/false/no become booleans.

evals.prompt: Does colorbox_simple_load have its own settings page, and where do the lightbox style and default size come from? What module does it require?
evals.expected_output: It has no configuration page of its own (configure is null). It requires the Colorbox module, and all lightbox styling, default sizes and mobile-detect behaviour come from Colorbox's own settings (colorbox.settings). This module only adds the per-link colorbox-load trigger and URL-param overrides.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a custom block labelled 'csl_known' that uses colorbox_simple_load to open a link in a lightbox. Inspect the live block's body and state the pixel width the Colorbox lightbox will open at for that link.
evals.expected_output: The block body contains a colorbox-load link with href .../?width=600&height=400, so the lightbox opens at width 600 (mapped by the module to Colorbox's innerWidth=600).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a custom block (a block_content entity of type 'basic') labelled exactly 'csl_task' whose body HTML contains a link that uses colorbox_simple_load to open /node/1 in a Colorbox lightbox sized to a width of 800 and a height of 600. Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block_content (info=csl_task) whose body contains an anchor with class colorbox-load and an href whose query string sets width=800 and height=600 (e.g. href="/node/1?width=800&height=600"), which the module maps to Colorbox innerWidth=800 / innerHeight=600.

evals.prompt: I want a promo box on my site with a link that pops open our signup page at /node/1 in an overlay window that loads it as an embedded frame, and it should be about 900 pixels wide. Using the colorbox_simple_load module, add a custom block called 'csl_task' with such a link and save it live.
evals.expected_output: A block_content (info=csl_task) whose body contains an anchor with class colorbox-load and an href to /node/1 whose query string includes iframe=true (or iframe=yes) and width=900, e.g. href="/node/1?width=900&iframe=true".
